title: Pictures made of type
technique: A 3D scene is redrawn in pure black and white from the letters of one bitmap font.
music: The text advances two characters on every beat, the snare flips the whole frame to its negative, and the kick swells the model and flashes the big word white. Louder bars use smaller letters, and hi-hats scatter stray characters through the sentences.
as_processor: It redraws the incoming picture as running bitmap type in pure black and white: dark areas become the black void, bright areas flip to black type on white, and the take decides whether that fills the frame, a quadtree, a wallpaper grid, a corridor's doors and end wall, or the inside of a giant word.
words_with_input: THIS IS ANOTHER SCENE'S PICTURE, REDRAWN AS TYPE. ITS BRIGHTNESS IS CUT TO PURE BLACK AND WHITE AND EVERY CELL BECOMES A MONOSPACE BITMAP LETTER. BRIGHTNESS NEVER PICKS THE LETTER, ONLY ITS WEIGHT: BLANK, GREYED, REGULAR OR BOLD. THE TEXT MOVES TWO CHARACTERS A BEAT. THE SNARE INVERTS THE FRAME.

takes.name: Poster
takes.description: One lit model stands to one side of a black frame with a large grey block word behind it.
words: THIS PICTURE IS MADE OF TYPE. A 3D MODEL IS RENDERED, THEN A SHADER REDRAWS IT AS MONOSPACE BITMAP LETTERS IN PURE BLACK AND WHITE. BRIGHTNESS NEVER PICKS THE LETTER, ONLY ITS WEIGHT: BLANK, GREYED, REGULAR OR BOLD. LIT AREAS FLIP TO BLACK TYPE ON WHITE. THE TEXT MOVES TWO CHARACTERS A BEAT. LOUDER BARS USE SMALLER LETTERS. THE SNARE INVERTS THE FRAME. THE KICK FLASHES THE BIG WORD WHITE.

takes.name: Wall
takes.description: The whole frame is small type with every row scrolling as its own ticker in alternating directions, and an oversized model appears only as a negative silhouette.
words: EVERY ROW IS ITS OWN TICKER. ALTERNATE ROWS RUN OPPOSITE WAYS. A ROW MOVES 2, 4 OR 6 CHARACTERS A BEAT. THE 3D MODEL IS NOT DRAWN: WHERE IT IS LIT, THE WALL OF TYPE TURNS TO INVERSE VIDEO. THIS IS 12 X 16 PIXEL MONOSPACE, THE SMALLEST SIZE USED HERE. THE SNARE FLIPS THE WHOLE WALL.

takes.name: Macro
takes.description: The camera sits very close to the model and tilts, so a few giant chunky letters lie over an abstract shaded surface.
words: MACRO: EVERY FONT PIXEL IS DRAWN 2 OR 3 SCREEN PIXELS WIDE. LIGHT TURNS THE TYPE TO BLACK ON WHITE.

takes.name: Page
takes.description: A white page with black type shows three different models side by side from above, with a small word as a header at the top left.
words: THE SAME SHADER WITH THE FRAME INVERTED: A WHITE PAGE OF BLACK TYPE. THREE 3D MODELS SEEN FROM ABOVE ARE REDRAWN AS BLOCKS OF MONOSPACE BITMAP TEXT. THEIR LIT SIDES PRINT BLACK, THE EMPTY SPACE AROUND THEM IS PAPER. THE PAGE IS TYPED IN FROM THE LEFT AT EACH CUT. THE SNARE TURNS IT BLACK.

takes.name: Corridor
takes.description: There is no model here, only a corridor drawn in type with ceiling tubes, a checker carpet, doors and a small word on the far wall.
words: NO 3D MODEL HERE. THIS CORRIDOR IS A FEW LINES OF SHADER MATHS: ONE DIVIDE GIVES DEPTH, THEN STRIPES BECOME CEILING TUBES, A CHECKER BECOMES CARPET AND RECTANGLES BECOME DOORS. THE RESULT IS A BRIGHTNESS MAP, REDRAWN AS MONOSPACE BITMAP TYPE. IT TRAVELS HALF A TUBE EVERY BEAT. THE KICK MAKES THE TUBES SURGE.

takes.name: Quadtree
takes.description: Letter size is chosen block by block from local contrast, so huge letters fill the empty areas and tiny ones trace the edges of a large cropped model.
words: QUADTREE: THE FRAME STARTS AS 96 X 128 PIXEL LETTERS. A BLOCK SPLITS IN FOUR WHEREVER THE PICTURE INSIDE IT HAS CONTRAST, DOWN TO 12 X 16. FLAT AREAS KEEP HUGE LETTERS, EDGES GET TINY ONES. A KICK SPLITS MORE BLOCKS.

takes.name: Wallpaper
takes.description: The picture repeats as a grid of three to five tiles a side, alternate tiles mirrored and in negative, and the checker pattern swaps on each beat.
words: ONE RENDER OF A 3D MODEL, REPEATED AS A GRID OF 3 TO 5 TILES A SIDE. EVERY OTHER COLUMN IS MIRRORED. EVERY OTHER TILE IS DRAWN IN NEGATIVE, AND THAT CHECKER SWAPS ON EACH BEAT. THE LETTERS ARE NOT TILED: ONE PAGE OF 12 PIXEL TYPE RUNS ACROSS ALL OF THEM.

takes.name: Keyhole
takes.description: The picture exists only inside a giant cropped word, with the model as a black hole outlined in white and the surroundings filling with grey type on kicks and beats.
words: THE BIG WORD IS A WINDOW. THE PAGE OF TYPE EXISTS ONLY INSIDE ITS LETTERS. THE 3D MODEL IS A BLACK HOLE IN THAT PAGE, WITH A WHITE OUTLINE THAT CARRIES ON OUTSIDE THE WORD. KICKS AND BEATS FILL THE DARK AROUND IT WITH GREYED TYPE FOR A MOMENT.
